name: Ducklett
description: Ducklett, the Water Bird Pokémon. Able to evolve into Swanna. A Water and Flying type.
pokedex_entries: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
